raw.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business in Russian speaker markets. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in Russian speaker markets. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • You speak Russian on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €55K – €75K

Nachdem wir uns als Marktführer in der Zahnmedizin etabliert haben, gehen wir jetzt den nächsten großen Schritt: neue medizinische Fachbereiche, neue Länder, neue Produkte. Als erster Designer oder erste Designerin verantwortest du, wie unsere Brand aussieht und wie sich unser Produkt anfühlt, vom Interface, das Praxen täglich nutzen, bis zu den Assets, die uns neue gewinnen. Wieso praxipal? Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (DACH ist aktuell unser wichtigster Markt) und gutes Englisch. Was du tun wirst Du gestaltest die Produktoberflächen unseres Kernprodukts, mit denen Praxen täglich arbeiten. Du machst aus unklaren Problemstellungen klare, nutzbare Flows, gemeinsam mit unserem Product Management und Software Engineering. Du baust und pflegst ein schlankes Design-System, damit das ganze Team konsistent und markenkonform arbeiten kann. Du ownst unsere visuelle Identität und produzierst die Marketing-, Event- und Social-Media-Assets, die unseren Growth-Motor befeuern. Du machst komplexe KI-Technologie für die Nutzer im Gesundheitssystem greifbar. Du hast Taste und hebst die Design-Qualität im gesamten Unternehmen. Als Europas größter digitaler Parkraumbewirtschafter betreiben wir über 4.000 Parkflächen mit smarten Freeflow-Kamerasystemen. Wir digitalisieren das gesamte Parkerlebnis – von kostenfreien Stellplätzen über bezahltes Parken bis hin zu unserer eigenen App-Plattform.

Bleibt ein Vorgang unbezahlt, ermitteln wir die Fahrzeughalter und wickeln die Nachverfolgung fair sowie rechtssicher ab. Als Collection Operations & Process Manager (all genders) bist du das operative und analytische Herzstück genau dieser Nachverfolgungsprozesse.

Du steuerst und optimierst die europäischen Workflows von der behördlichen Halterdatenabfrage über den Mahnversand bis zur Schnittstelle für Customer Care und externe Inkassopartner.

What to expect

  • End-to-End Operations: Du verantwortest das reibungslose Ineinandergreifen unserer automatisierten Datenflüsse, wie beispielsweise bei der komplexen Halterdatenermittlung. Treten strukturelle Fehler auf, erarbeitest du verlässliche Fallback-Optionen.

  • Compliance: Datenschutz und lokale EU-Vorgaben sind für dich die Basis für sicheres Arbeiten. Du sorgst pragmatisch dafür, dass neue Richtlinien smart und nahtlos in unsere Arbeitsabläufe integriert werden.

  • Internationale Expansion: Du begleitest unser europäisches Wachstum, indem du unsere Collection-Strategien kontinuierlich an neue Märkte und lokale Zahlungsgewohnheiten anpasst.

  • Datengetriebene Analysen: Du überwachst unsere Performance-Metriken (z. B. in Metabase). Wenn Zahlen schwanken, gehst du dem Problem auf den Grund und initiierst die passenden Lösungen.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Ob Tech-Team, Customer Success oder externe Partner – du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Collection-Themen, bündelst die unterschiedlichen Anforderungen und sorgst für klare Strukturen im Projektalltag.

Inspire us by

  • Erfahrung: Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Operations, Projektmanagement oder Prozesssteuerung mit Berührungspunkten im operativen Forderungsmanagement, Inkassoumfeld oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

  • Kritisches & Analytisches Denken: Du gibst dich nicht mit oberflächlichen Antworten zufrieden und hinterfragst den Status quo. Du bist stark darin, tiefgehende Root-Cause-Analysen durchzuführen, um die wahren Ursachen hinter den Zahlen zu verstehen und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Daten- & Tech-Affinität: Du arbeitest extrem datengetrieben, fühlst dich in Excel/Google Sheets sowie gängigen BI-Tools zu Hause und bringst ein ausgeprägtes technisches Grundverständnis mit.

  • Methodenkompetenz: Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management sowie eine ausgeprägte „Hands-on“- und Problemlösungsmentalität. Du denkst Prozesse stets end-to-end und fokussierst dich auf Skalierbarkeit.

  • Regulatorisches Verständnis: Ein solides Grundverständnis für Datenschutz und Inkassoregularien, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, sich schnell in die rechtlichen Vorgaben verschiedener europäischer Märkte einzuarbeiten.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift.

What we offer

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Dein Arbeitsalltag, deine Performance - Unser hybrides Modell ermöglicht dir fokussiertes arbeiten im Homeoffice, frische Perspektiven in der Workation sowie persönlichen Austausch an unseren Anchor-Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag)

  • Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

  • Teamkultur & Networking: Echte Verbindungen – auch abseits vom Daily Business. Feier Erfolge mit uns bei legendären Teamevents und Spirit Days

  • Produktive Umgebung: Brainfood Deluxe - Ob Siebträger-Kaffee, Bella&Bona Online-Kantine, frisches Obst oder Müsli Bar. Dein Wohlbefinden ist die Basis für starke Performance

  • Gesundheit & Ausgleich: Bleib in Balance mit EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club - deutschlandweit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen

  • Dresscode? Dein Code: Bei uns zählt, was du bewegst – nicht, was du trägst. Zieh an, worin du dich am wohlsten fühlst

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

integration</li> <li>Proficiency in C/C++ and/or MAVLink communication protocols or equivalent Datalink protocols</li> <li>Experience with UAV sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and flight controller configuration</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux-based development and debugging environments</li> <li>Experience with UAV flight testing, system validation, and troubleshooting in real-world operational environments</li> <li>Understanding of drone manufacturing, QC processes, and End-of-Line testing methodologies is a plus</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
description: About the Run & Grow: Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement. Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses. Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.   What you'll do: Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go. Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing. Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently. Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance. Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up. Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response. Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions. Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you   You'll be great for this role if you: Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences. Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.   Why you should join SumUp: 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks . 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp 🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.   About us: Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.  SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram . Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer II
description: About the team Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights. As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI. What you'll do Design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability. Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency. Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving. Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability. Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation. Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work. title: Production Scheduler
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Build the machine that builds the machine . Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them. Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology . Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology. Do work that matters, and see it grow . The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world. Make an impact you can point to . In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck. YOUR IMPACT Create and maintain detailed, day-to-day production schedules that translate the production plan into executable work on the manufacturing floor. Monitor progress, resolve scheduling conflicts, and adapt plans in real time as priorities and conditions change. Enable predictable delivery of critical fusion hardware while improving efficiency, coordination, and transparency across manufacturing operations. WHAT YOU WILL DO Develop, maintain and continuously optimize detailed production schedules across multiple manufacturing work centers. Sequence and re-sequence work orders day-to-day to reflect real-time engineering priorities, material availability and manufacturing constraints. Monitor manufacturing progress in real time and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and bottlenecks, implementing mitigation plans to protect critical program milestones. Coordinate with the Procurement & Logistics Department to flag near-term material shortages and adjust the schedule to keep work centers running. Balance day-to-day workloads across internal and external manufacturing resources in line with the capacity plan. Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to reflect process changes in the active schedule as soon as they take effect. Partner with Program Managers to keep them informed of schedule status and re-prioritize work when program objectives shift. Analyze schedule performance and identify emerging risks to delivery timelines, escalating issues before they impact critical milestones. Generate and monitor key execution metrics, including schedule adherence, work order completion, lead times and work-in-progress. Contribute to the development of scalable scheduling processes and tools as Proxima transitions from prototype manufacturing to industrial deployment. WHO YOU ARE You have a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in production scheduling, manufacturing operations or supply chain within a complex engineering environment (aerospace, fusion, automotive, energy or other high-tech manufacturing industries). You have experience with production scheduling systems, MRP/ERP workflows and manufacturing data management and are excited by the opportunity to help implement and shape planning tools in a rapidly growing manufacturing organization. You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments where priorities evolve quickly and scheduling decisions have a direct, immediate impact on manufacturing execution. You are comfortable working close to the shop floor, spotting bottlenecks early and driving conflicts to resolution. You communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and can balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You are proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable working in an evolving hardware development environment. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

TEAM AND ROLE

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Computational Physicist - Stellarator Optimization, you will design the magnetic fields and coils at the core of our stellarators. You will balance plasma performance with engineering requirements, prioritizing simple, practical designs that can be built. Your work will directly shape Stellaris, our first commercial fusion power plant.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will shape the “heart” of the stellarator: the magnetic field that confines the plasma and the coils that create it.

  • Release optimized plasma and coil geometries that engineering teams use to design magnets, supporting structures, and surrounding sub-systems.

  • Resolve design trade-offs between physics, engineering and assembly requirements.

  • Own research projects that overcome technical challenges. Choose questions by their impact to the stellarator and carry the answers through to engineering decisions.

  • Deliver results in time for design milestones, with clear recommendations, checked assumptions, and uncertainties that engineers can work with.

    WHO YOU ARE

  • You have strong mathematical reasoning and experience solving difficult computational problems. You can work from first principles and choose methods that fit the question.

  • You have independently driven research to useful outcomes, in academia or industry. You can frame an ambiguous problem, set priorities, and deliver without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You understand that designs need to meet requirements and deadlines. You know when to investigate further and when to commit to a validated solution.

  • You write clear, reliable scientific code. You are comfortable with Python, or can become productive in it quickly, and use testing, version control, and code review.

  • You have a master’s degree in a STEM field, or equivalent experience. We welcome physicists, mathematicians, engineers, computer scientists, and researchers from other quantitative backgrounds. A PhD is not required.

  • Prior fusion, tokamak, or stellarator experience is not required. You bring the computational attitude and willingness to learn the physics.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of the 20 largest construction companies in the German-speaking region already rely on Kuro every day, representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

One year after launch, Kuro runs every day inside the back offices of DACH’s largest construction companies, which together build more than €40 billion a year. We automate their core workflows and help them make faster, better decisions.

We’re just getting started. The construction software companies that reached billion-dollar scale did it by owning core back-office workflows, and that’s where we already are. With AI, we believe the next category leader can be 10x bigger. We raised a €10M seed round to build it.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As GTM Manager, you'll play a key role in driving Kuro's commercial growth by generating new business opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and turning go-to-market initiatives into results. You'll be hands-on across the customer journey, from prospecting and building relationships to supporting POCs and transforming them into long-term customer relationships.

You'll work directly with our Founding GTM Manager to bring our go-to-market strategy to life, while collaborating closely with our Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. Together, you'll strengthen our commercial activities, improve how we engage and convert customers, and help scale Kuro's go-to-market engine as the company grows.

What You'll Do

  • Drive top-of-funnel activities through prospecting, targeted outreach, lead qualification, and relationship building.

  • Manage and develop customer opportunities from first contact through product demonstrations, POCs, and commercial discussions.

  • Create compelling customer presentations, proposals, and business cases to support commercial conversations.

  • Maintain and improve CRM, pipeline reporting, and sales processes, including identifying opportunities for automation.

  • Work closely with the Founding GTM Manager to execute commercial initiatives, coordinate customer-facing activities, and share relevant market and product feedback.

Your Profile

  • 2–4 years of experience in business development, sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

  • Proven hands-on experience in prospecting, outbound sales, pipeline generation, and managing customer relationships.

  • Strong commercial mindset and communication skills, with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Technical curiosity and an analytical, structured approach to solving problems and identifying opportunities.

  • Proactive, highly driven, and execution-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Fluent in German and English (more languages are a plus).

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

The process

  1. Talent Acquisition Call - Intro, fit, motivation & logistics (30 min)

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive & Get to know Product (45 min)

  3. Challenge: A time-boxed challenge (≤4 hours)

  4. Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

  5. Final Culture Interview (45 Min)

description: Description Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important. As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? raw.title: Working Student - Customer Care (f/m/d)
raw.description:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid builds portable battery power systems for trades and pros. Our Pilot Fleet is how customers try them out before they buy. As a Working Student in Customer Care, you keep that fleet running. You handle demo requests, shipments, returns, check-ups, service and upgrades, and you support the team with everyday tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processes.

You’ve done a great job when demo units are ready whenever Sales needs them, turnaround times stay short, the pool data in Salesforce and NetSuite is accurate, and our monthly fleet analytics give Customer Care and Sales leads a clear view of utilization and demo-to-order conversion.

Your Impact

  • Pilot requests: Receive, review and prioritize incoming demo requests, confirm unit availability and maintain an accurate Pilot Fleet inventory

  • Fulfillment: Prepare, pack and dispatch pilot units with the appropriate accessories, issue shipping and return documentation and track each unit from dispatch through to return

  • Communication: Maintain close contact with the Sales team and customers to ensure seamless delivery and pickup

  • Inspection and service: Coordinate inspections and functional tests of returned units with the Service team and schedule repairs and upgrades to bring units back into circulation quickly

  • Analytics: Maintain Pilot Fleet reporting (utilization, turnaround time, demo-to-order conversion, fleet condition) and prepare monthly insights for Customer Care and Sales leads

  • Process improvement: Identify friction points in the demo process, propose solutions and help document standard procedures in Confluence

  • Customer Care support: Support the team with day-to-day support tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processing

  • Enablement: Support all stakeholders involved through structured documentation and process support

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a comparable field

  • Availability of 16–20 hours per week during the semester, with increased capacity during semester breaks, on-site in Ludwigsburg

  • A hands-on, structured approach to work and a strong sense of ownership for maintaining a physical fleet and the data that supports it

  • Proficiency in working with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT)

  • Dependable and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests effectively

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Nice to have: German language skills and initial exposure to enterprise software (Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite)

Your Benefits

  • Real ownership: from day one, the live Pilot Fleet is yours to run, with real responsibility instead of busywork

  • Flexibility for your studies: working hours coordinated around your lectures and exams

  • Broad experience: learn how a hardware company works end to end, from customer care and sales to service and operations

  • Hands-on tool skills: work with Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira and Confluence in a real business setting

  • Direct access to a lean, senior team: honest feedback, and room to push back and make your ideas count

  • Time to recharge: generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

title: Marketing Manager
description: Du liebst es, Events auf die Beine zu stellen, und weißt, wie man Social-Media-Kanäle lebendig hält? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Messen und Veranstaltungen reibungslos laufen und unsere Social-Media-Kanäle konsequent bespielt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen, hältst im Team die Fäden zusammen und wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel. Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Marketingteam, in dem deine Ideen gehört und umgesetzt werden. Deine Aufgaben: Du recherchierst und bewertest neue Messen und Veranstaltungen und bringst sie für uns an den Start. Du planst und setzt Messen, Netzwerkveranstaltungen, Webinare und Objektvorstellungen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung um. Du übernimmst die komplette Organisation rund um jedes Event: Anmeldung, Standplanung, Hotel und Reise, Material sowie die Abstimmung mit Ausstellern und Dienstleistern. Du begleitest eigene Formate wie Tage der offenen Tür, Preisbewerbungen und Postmailings. Du bereitest jedes Event sauber nach: Du übergibst Kontakte ins CRM, sammelst Fotos und Material und hältst Learnings fest. Du steuerst unsere Social-Media-Kanäle (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), planst Beiträge nach Redaktionsplan ein und veröffentlichst sie. Du betreust Stories, zum Beispiel Einblicke hinter die Kulissen und von unterwegs, und kümmerst dich um das Community-Management. Du hältst Kanäle und Profile aktuell und gestaltest die Ausrichtung der Kanäle aktiv mit. Du recherchierst Themen, schreibst Texte und Captions und erstellst Briefings für Grafik und Video. Du lieferst Werbetexte und Kampagnenideen zu, vor allem zu Events und Content-Themen, und bereitest die Event-Bewerbung gemeinsam mit unserem Performance Marketing Manager vor. Du bereitest Marketing-Sprints und Jour fixes vor und nach, pflegst die Mitschriften und hältst offene Punkte nach. Das bringst du mit: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Event- oder Medienmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung im Event- und Messemanagement, im Social-Media-Management oder idealerweise in beidem. Sicherer Umgang mit Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und YouTube sowie ein gutes Gespür für Inhalte, die ankommen. Stilsichere Texte: Du formulierst Captions, Beiträge und Werbetexte, die auf den Punkt sind. Organisationstalent und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen. Ein freundliches und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Ausstellern, Dienstleistern und Gästen. Reisebereitschaft für Messen und Veranstaltungen. Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Tool sowie mit einem CRM ist ein Plus. Erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Microsoft Copilot und Lust, dein Wissen darin auszubauen und KI im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Wünschenswert: Interesse an Immobilien und Kapitalanlagen. Was wir dir bieten: Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn in einem Unternehmen, das dringend benötigte Pflegeplätze schafft. Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit 40 Stunden pro Woche. Attraktives Jahresgehalt (Fixgehalt zuzüglich Bonusregelung). 28 Tage Urlaub; zusätzlich hast du an Rosenmontag ganz sowie an Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei. Einen Gesundheitsbonus in Form eines Personal Trainers. Einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz in der Düsseldorfer Innenstadt, gut erreichbar mit Bus und Bahn. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und gezielte Weiterbildung, auch im Umgang mit KI. Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Du wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. So arbeiten wir: Wir arbeiten bewusst gemeinsam vor Ort. Die Stelle ist eine Präsenzstelle in unserem Büro in Düsseldorf. Kurze Wege, schnelle Abstimmung und ein Team, das sich kennt, gehören für uns zur Qualität unserer Arbeit. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d, Vollzeit)
description: Du steuerst bezahlte Kampagnen nicht nach Gefühl, sondern nach Zahlen, und weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was einen guten Lead von einem teuren unterscheidet? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Performance Marketing Manager setzt du unsere bezahlten Kampagnen auf, steuerst und wertest sie aus, damit qualifizierte Leads bei unserem Vertrieb ankommen. Du bist der Filter zwischen Anzeige und Beratungsgespräch und verantwortest deine Kampagnen vom ersten Tag an eigenständig. Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel. Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketingleitung und Vertrieb zusammen und siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag deine Kampagnen zum Geschäftserfolg leisten. Deine Aufgaben: Du baust Kampagnen in Meta, Google und LinkedIn auf und steuerst sie im Rahmen eines festen Quartalsbudgets. Du baust Google Ads als eigenen Schwerpunkt aus: Search und Display, Keywords, negative Keywords und Suchintentionen. Du richtest ein sauberes Tracking ein, inklusive UTM-Parametern, und verknüpfst die Kampagnen mit HubSpot. Du optimierst laufende Kampagnen kontinuierlich über Zielgruppen, Gebote, Creatives und A/B-Tests. Du entwickelst Wording und Framing für Objekt- und Rabattaktionen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung. Du briefst Bild-Creatives bei unserem Digital Designer und Videos bei unserem Video Editor und prüfst sie vor dem Go-live auf Briefing und Plattformformate. Du wertest deine Kampagnen aus: Kosten pro Lead, Anteil qualifizierter Leads, Terminquote und Kosten pro Abschluss. Du pflegst das Marketing-Dashboard in HubSpot auf Kampagnenebene und lieferst die Kennzahlen für das monatliche Reporting an die Marketingleitung. Du prüfst und qualifizierst eingehende Leads vor, bevor sie in ein Beratungsgespräch gehen, und spielst die Rückmeldungen zur Lead-Qualität in Kampagnen und Framing zurück. Das bringst du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Performance Marketing, in der du Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich aufgesetzt, gesteuert und ausgewertet hast. Nachweisbare Praxis mit Meta Ads und Google Ads (Search und Display); Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Ads ist ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Leadgenerierung mit klarem Fokus auf Lead-Qualität und Kosten pro Abschluss, nicht nur auf Lead-Menge, idealerweise bei erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten wie Immobilien, Kapitalanlagen oder Finanzdienstleistungen. Sicherer Umgang mit Tracking, UTM-Parametern und Conversion-Messung sowie mit Analyse- und Reporting-Tools. Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Tool sowie mit einem CRM. Verantwortung für feste Werbebudgets und die Fähigkeit, Budgets zielgerichtet einzusetzen und einzuhalten. Ein analytisches, zahlengetriebenes Denken und gleichzeitig ein gutes Gespür für Botschaften, die Zielgruppen überzeugen. Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du brauchst keine lange Einarbeitung, sondern legst nach kurzer Einführung in unsere Prozesse direkt los. title: Applied AI Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.&nbsp; Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.</p> <p>In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.</p> <p>Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: <strong>Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship</strong>.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a member of the Tech Data, AI &amp; UX team allocated to European &amp; Asian Power Trading in Berlin, you will build the services, infrastructure, and AI &amp; data platforms that power the business, enabling teams to improve their data-driven decisions and connect innovative products.</p> <p>As part of this Joint Venture, the Applied AI Engineer will help to evolve ECTP’s AI &amp; Agentic platforms – a strategic, firm-wide initiative led by the Tech Data, AI &amp; UX team. The role provides hands-on exposure to the cutting edge of enterprise AI, working alongside experienced data engineer, architects and quant developers in a live, production-grade environment.</p> <p>You will work closely with trading desk and Technology teams to build core agentic infrastructure, integrate tooling via AWS Lambda and MCP servers, develop agent skills, and configure knowledge bases across user, chat, agent, and application contexts. You will explore and evaluate open-source and proprietary connectors within the rapidly evolving LLM and Generative AI ecosystem, and help roll out individual productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code. All solutions will be hosted securely within Engelhart’s internal network, with models deployed in a dedicated VPC and governed access to firm data, with a strong preference for AWS-native and Bedrock-based architectures.</p> <p>This will be a full-time role, owning the following <strong>responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with the trading desk to supercharge their research capabilities and data-driven insights by extending Engelhart's core AI and agentic platform to address new trading desk requirements.</li> <li>Assist in the set-up and configuration of core agentic AI infrastructure, including orchestration layers, agent runtimes, and supporting services, deployed securely within Engelhart’s AWS VPC.</li> <li>Build and maintain agent tooling integrations via AWS Lambda functions and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, enabling agents to interact with firm data, APIs, and internal systems.</li> <li>Develop agent skills and configure knowledge bases, including document stores, vector databases (e.g. Postgres with pgvector, AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases), and retrieval pipelines for user, chat, agent, and application contexts.</li> <li>Research, evaluate, and help integrate open-source and proprietary accelerators, connectors, and frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, etc) into the platform, assessing fitness for purpose in a regulated, IP-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Support the deployment and end-user adoption of individual AI productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude Code, ensuring secure configuration and appropriate access controls within Engelhart’s internal network.</li> <li>Contribute to technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and internal knowledge sharing on AI tooling, design decisions, and implementation patterns to support team learning and continuity.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to iteratively test and improve agentic workflows, gathering feedback and translating it into technical improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <p>This person will be a technically minded and genuinely curious person who is excited about the transformative potential of AI and wants to go beyond surface-level tooling – you want to understand how things work and help build them. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, energised by fast-moving technology landscapes, and take pride in writing clean, well-structured code. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to something that has real, visible impact within a live business setting.</p> <p>The following <strong>education, experiences and skills</strong> are essential for application:</p> <ul> <li>Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related technical undergraduate degree.</li> <li>A genuine passion for AI, Large Language Models, and Generative AI. Not just as a user, but with curiosity about how they work and how to build with them.</li> <li>Proficient in Python, with hands-on experience writing scripts, working with APIs, or building small applications – whether through coursework, personal projects, or hackathons.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud concepts or services (preference for AWS), containerisation (Docker), or REST APIs – even if only at an introductory or project level.</li> <li>A proactive, self-directed learning style – able to research unfamiliar technologies, synthesise documentation, and form a view on trade-offs with limited guidance.</li> <li>Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues, and to work effectively in a small, fast-moving team.</li> <li>A collaborative, team-oriented mindset, with the confidence to contribute ideas, ask questions, and engage actively with engineers, data scientists, and business users.</li> <li>An organised approach to work, with attention to detail, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapid change, with the resilience to iterate quickly, adapt to new findings, and thrive in a technology landscape that evolves week to week.</li> </ul> <p>In addition, the following criteria is not required, but highly desirable for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Foundational knowledge of energy trading markets, including core concepts like balancing mechanism operations, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs).</li> <li>Prior exposure to LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar; experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma); or familiarity with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent managed AI services.</li> <li>Experience with version control (Git) and basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines or infrastructure-as-code (e.g. AWS CloudFormation, CDK).</li> <li>Understanding of prompt engineering techniques, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-agent system design patterns.</li> <li>Participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source contributions, personal projects involving LLMs or automation, or active engagement with the AI development community (e.g. Hugging Face, GitHub, LangChain forums).</li> <li>Portuguese as a second language.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.</li> <li>28 days of annual holiday entitlement plus Berlin public holidays.</li> <li>€3,000 per year contribution to a private pension scheme on your behalf.</li> <li>€20 monthly subsidy towards BVG tickets.</li> <li>€25 monthly subsidy towards ClassPass membership.</li> <li>A subsidy for German language courses to help you immerse yourself in the local culture.</li> <li>A sociable working environment with an open, international culture.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description: At Haut.AI , we make skin measurable. We give beauty and wellness brands skin intelligence: AI that analyzes skin from a selfie, simulates how it may change over time, and guides every consumer to the right products. Our technology, including AI Skin Analysis, SkinGPT and Skin.Chat, powers personalized, science-backed experiences online and in store. Today, more than 100 global beauty brands use our technology, including enterprise companies like Neutrogena, Beiersdorf, Ulta Beauty, Grupo Boticário and OLAY. We are looking for a Head of Revenue to own Haut.AI ’s full commercial engine: new business and customer success in one function and lead a team of six exceptional teammates. This is a player-coach role reporting directly to our CEO. What you will do: Own the revenue number. You own new business, renewals and expansion, plus the forecast and the commercial KPIs. You give leadership a clear view of where things really stand. Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach and develop three Account Executives and Account Managers. Run weekly pipeline reviews and one-on-ones that focus on growth as much as on numbers. Coach deal by deal and account by account. Join calls and demos, and give specific feedback while it is fresh. Set a clear standard for discovery, proposals, pricing and demo prep. Carry the biggest deals yourself. Lead a small set of our largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities. Personally manage our most valuable client relationships at senior level. Keep complex buying groups moving. Enterprise beauty deals involve brand and marketing, e-commerce, IT, data privacy, legal and procurement. You map the group, align it and keep it moving toward signature. Build the system the team runs on. This means playbooks and objection handling, and a clean handoff from Account Executive to Account Manager once a deal closes. It also means CS operations from onboarding to renewal and expansion, and health scores that surface risk early. Put AI to work across revenue. Find where AI cuts busywork and sharpens decisions: call prep, deal reviews, proposals, account health. Get hands-on with the tools; don’t stop at writing the plan. Stay close to clients and bring back what you learn. Sit in on onboarding and business reviews. Turn client feedback into real input for Product and Marketing, and bring pricing and packaging signals back from the market. What makes you a fit: An experienced commercial leader. You have 8+ years in B2B SaaS commercial roles, including 3+ years leading a team. Ideally you have owned both new business and account management or customer success. A player-coach. You have built and led a commercial team, and you still enjoy running a deal, reviewing the proposal and joining the call. Your team follows your example. At home with enterprise. You have closed complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders and long sales cycles. You are comfortable in the room with senior leaders, with exceptional English and real executive presence. A high-agency builder. You have built commercial processes, playbooks and KPI frameworks yourself, not just run someone else’s. You would rather put a working playbook in front of the team this week than perfect it for next quarter. Evidence over opinion. You know HubSpot or a similar CRM inside out. You read call recordings, check CRM hygiene and turn activity data into clear next actions. You can explain a forecast in plain language. You own outcomes, not activities, and you finish what you start, even with a lot on your plate in a small, fast-moving remote team. AI-native in how you work. You use AI tools daily and have clear views on where they help a revenue team and where they do not. Curious about skin science. You want to understand how our science turns into business value for beauty brands, and you learn fast. Nice to have: experience selling to beauty, retail or e-commerce brands and retailers, selling API or platform products, or selling across Europe and North America. title: Manager (m/w/d) Einkaufsberatung
description: Deine Rolle bei ProcuVia Unser Ansatz ist pragmatisch, umsetzungsorientiert und ergebnisgetrieben. Wir analysieren nicht nur Einsparpotenziale, sondern setzen sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden um – insbesondere durch die gezielte Vorbereitung und Durchführung anspruchsvoller Verhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager (m/w/d) mit ausgeprägtem Verhandlungsgeschick, unternehmerischem Denken und dem Anspruch, Einkaufsergebnisse nachhaltig zu verbessern. Deine Aufgaben Du führst eigenständig anspruchsvolle Preis- und Konditionsverhandlungen mit nationalen und internationalen Lieferanten. Du entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Verhandlungsstrategien auf Basis fundierter Kostenanalysen, Marktbenchmarks und Lieferantenbewertungen. Du realisierst nachhaltige Einsparungen durch die Optimierung von Preisen, Rabatten, Zahlungsbedingungen, Vertragslaufzeiten und weiteren kommerziellen Konditionen. Du bereitest Verhandlungen systematisch vor, definierst Zielkonditionen, Verhandlungsspielräume und alternative Szenarien und setzt diese konsequent um. Du hinterfragst bestehende Lieferantenbeziehungen und Beschaffungsstrukturen und identifizierst zusätzliche kommerzielle Optimierungspotenziale. Du dokumentierst und validierst die erzielten Einsparungen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Ergebnisse tatsächlich beim Kunden wirksam werden. Du agierst als kompetenter Sparringspartner für Einkaufsleiter, Category Manager und Geschäftsführungen. Du steuerst Lieferantenprozesse, Ausschreibungen und kommerzielle Neuverhandlungen von der Vorbereitung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dein Profil Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet, oder über eine gleichwertige praktische Qualifikation. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf eines Industrieunternehmen mit Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus der Einkaufsberatung mit. Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung komplexer Preis- und Konditionsverhandlungen sowie bei der Realisierung substanzieller Kosteneinsparungen erzielt. Du beherrschst professionelle Verhandlungstechniken und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Interessen zu analysieren, Verhandlungsspielräume auszuschöpfen und tragfähige Vereinbarungen zu erzielen. Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Kostenstrukturen, Total Cost of Ownership, Marktpreise und kommerzielle Vertragsbedingungen. Du überzeugst durch Durchsetzungsvermögen, strategisches Geschick, analytische Stärke und ein souveränes Auftreten auf allen Hierarchieebenen. Du bist ergebnisorientiert, kommunikationsstark und in der Lage, auch in anspruchsvollen Verhandlungssituationen überzeugend und professionell aufzutreten. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und bringst Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Lieferantenverhandlungen mit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description: About Nexoya We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us. The role You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production. How we build software AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it. Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority. Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together. Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change. You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked. What you will do Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud. raw.description:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

How we build software

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

  • Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

  • Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation.

What you bring

  • [3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience.

  • Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred).

  • You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain.

Bonus: ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta) or attribution; AI or agent features in production (Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, MCP, RAG); LLM evaluation or observability; team use of Claude Code or similar; data pipelines; German.

What we offer

  • Direct impact on how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously.

  • A genuine AI-first culture: experiment, automate, share.

  • A transparent culture at eye level, with regular team events.

  • Strategy Days twice a year where the whole team shapes company strategy (past: Helsinki, Berlin, Belgrade, Swiss Alps, Zurich).

Application process

  2. Take-home assignment: a backend feature

  3. Technical discussion with the engineering team

  4. [On-site] interview and team evaluation

title: CX Manager (d/w/m)
description: Deine Mission Deine Insights und Projekte sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen dauerhaft bei SpotmyEnergy bleiben. Als CX Manager erkennst Du früh, wo Kund:innen unzufrieden werden, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI, unser Team und unsere Kund:innen immer auf dem aktuellen Stand sind. Du verbindest Wissensdatenbank, Kundendaten und Kundenkommunikation zu einem Kreislauf. Dein Maßstab: weniger Tickets je Kunde, mehr Fälle im First Level gelöst und noch bessere Bewertungen. Unser KI-Assistent Lumi ist in Tickets, Chat und Hotline bereits vorgeschaltet. Du sorgst dafür, dass es die richtigen Antworten gibt. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unserer VP Customer Experience zusammen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Themen, bis Du sie vollständig verantwortest. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Du verantwortest unsere Wissensdatenbank: Du hältst sie aktuell, vollständig und widerspruchsfrei, für Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und unser Team. Du machst unseren KI-Assistenten Lumi besser: Du prüfst seine Antworten, vergleichst sie mit anderen KI-Tools und schärfst über die Wissensdatenbank nach. Du arbeitest jede Produktänderung zeitnah in Wissensdatenbank und Kundenkommunikation ein und gibst neue Informationen an unsere Teams und unsere KI weiter. Du verantwortest unsere Auswertungen: Tickets, Anrufe, CSAT, NPS und Bewertungen. Daraus leitest Du konkrete Verbesserungen für Wissen, Prozesse und Kommunikation ab. Du entwickelst Frühwarnsysteme, die abwanderungsgefährdete Kund:innen erkennen, bevor sie kündigen, und stößt passende Maßnahmen an. Du zeigst unseren Fachabteilungen, was unsere Kund:innen brauchen und wo Probleme entstehen. Du findest gemeinsam mit Customer Service und Technical Support heraus, welche Anliegen künftig direkt im ersten Kontakt gelöst werden können. Du beantwortest Bewertungen auf Trustpilot, in den App Stores und bei Google. Du entwickelst unsere Standardkommunikation weiter, prüfst Zustellbarkeit und Wirkung und testest Varianten. Du lieferst unserem Produktteam auf Basis der Daten Inhalte und Anlässe, damit wir Kund:innen in allen Kanälen, auch in unserer App, im richtigen Moment informieren. Dein Profil Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, CRM oder einem verwandten Bereich und hast dort schon eigene Themen verantwortet. Du arbeitest täglich mit KI: Du schreibst gute Prompts und prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch. Idealerweise hast Du schon einen KI-Assistenten oder Chatbot konfiguriert, trainiert oder getestet. Du hast Kundendaten selbst ausgewertet und daraus konkrete Verbesserungen abgeleitet. Du behältst bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick, priorisierst selbst und lieferst Ergebnisse, die nicht nachgeschärft werden müssen. Du denkst in Prozessen und gibst Dich nicht mit Symptomen zufrieden. Du schreibst klar und kannst auch Themen wie Smart Meter oder dynamische Tarife verständlich erklären. Auch bei einer wütenden Bewertung triffst Du den richtigen Ton. Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch (C2). Erfahrung mit Wissensdatenbanken, HubSpot oder Bewertungsplattformen ist ein Plus. Unser Offer Wirkung, die bleibt: Deine Insights und Projekte entscheiden mit, ob Kund:innen dauerhaft bei SpotmyEnergy bleiben. Das zahlt direkt auf unser Wachstum ein. Echte Gestaltung: Du entscheidest, was Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und alle Mitarbeitenden über unsere Produkte wissen. KI im Alltag statt auf Folien: Du arbeitest mit den Tools, die wir täglich einsetzen, und baust auf Analysen auf, die schon vorbereitet sind. Nah an den Entscheidungen: Du berichtest direkt an unsere VP Customer Experience und arbeitest eng mit Customer Service, Technical Support und Produkt zusammen. Energiewende mitgestalten: ein Scale-up, das gerade stark wächst, mit Büro in Köln und einem starken Teamspirit. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
