description: At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own.  You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production.    Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva   Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions.   As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day.     Your work will directly contribute to:   Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe  Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets  Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC)  Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses  Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD)    What You’ll Do   Priva Digital Services & product engineering   Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart  Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value  Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration  Optimization & forecasting integration   Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
raw.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field

Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

  • You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

  • You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week

  • A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering

  • A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective

title: Werkstudent Fulfillment
description: Ben jij een HBO- of WO-student in een bedrijfseconomische en/of logistieke richting en wil je naast je studie relevante werkervaring opdoen? Bij Priva krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan verschillende projecten binnen een innovatieve en internationale organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Als werkstudent binnen Fulfilment ondersteun je verschillende teams en werk je mee aan projecten. Je gaat de ene keer aan de slag binnen één specifieke afdeling , en de andere keer ga je meewerken aan projecten die meerdere afdelingen raken. Fulfilment bestaat uit de afdelingen Production, Logistics & Warehousing, Supplier Quality Engineering en Procurement & Planning. Afhankelijk van het project houd je je onder andere bezig met: Ondersteunen van collega's bij operationele en administratieve werkzaamheden; Meewerken aan lopende projecten binnen de verschillende Fulfilment-afdelingen; Verzamelen, analyseren en verwerken van data; Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en meedenken over efficiëntere processen; Zelfstandig oppakken en uitvoeren van (LEAN-)deelprojecten. Zo doe je naast je studie waardevolle praktijkervaring op en krijg je de mogelijkheid om jouw kennis direct toe te passen binnen een professionele werkomgeving. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen. Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen. Wie ben jij? Wij zoeken een enthousiaste student die graag kennismaakt met de praktijk en initiatief durft te nemen. Daarnaast: Volg je een HBO- of WO-opleiding in een bedrijfseconomische en/of logistieke richting; Ben je 16 tot 24 uur per week beschikbaar, in overleg; Werk je analytisch en nauwkeurig; Beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden; Heb je een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding; Beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je krijgt? Naast een interessante bijbaan waarin je relevante werkervaring opdoet, bieden we je: Een uitdagende werkplek waarin je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en waardevolle praktijkervaring opdoet.  Een passend en marktconform salaris Bedrijfsrestaurant tegen betaalbare prijzen, gratis fruit en lekkere koffie in The Hub.  Een actieve personeelsvereniging & vitaliteitsteam met PrivaFit! Workshops waaraan je deel kan nemen.  Toegang tot onze gratis fitnessfaciliteiten op locatie, waar je kunt meedoen aan Crossfit-, Pilates-, Yoga- en Full Body Workout of speel een potje tafelvoetbal en tafeltennis mee. title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.     Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters   At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:  Physical/embedded device security.  OT (operational technology) network security.  OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.  Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.   What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun.  As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.  What you will be doing   As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors.  Security standards, policies, and design patterns library  Security architecture review process  Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation  Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register  Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.  Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies)  Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape  Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.  Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.   To succeed in this role:   You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will".  You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. raw.title: Security Architect
raw.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren. Wat ga je doen? Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Chief Information Security Officer
raw.description:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

•     Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

•     Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

•     Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

•     Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

•     Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

•     Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

•     Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

•     Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

•     CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

•     Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

•     Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

•     Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

•     Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

•     Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

•     Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

•     A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

•     Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

•     Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

•     Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

•     A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

•     Room and budget for personal and professional development

•     A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

•     Phone and travel allowance

•     Great home and remote working facilities

•     Lunch fee

•     Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.


About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.

title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
description: WAT GA JE DOEN? Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin; Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen; Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming; Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen; Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten; Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders; Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements; Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen. Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting. WIJ VRAGEN HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar. WIJ BIEDEN Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

About Airwallex

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Legal team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal minds and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal and financial risks.

What you’ll do

Airwallex is looking for an experienced (Senior) Counsel to support our fast growing commercial legal team across EMEA. You will support a complex set of fintech products that will challenge your problem solving and critical thinking skills. You will support a wide variety of commercial legal matters supporting Airwallex’s growing Sales team, and help us build for scale in several EMEA markets, ranging from Germany, Israel, France, the Netherlands to the UK. This is a strategic position and you will be a key advisor to Airwallex’s EMEA go-to-market Commercial team.

This position is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive complex deals. Personally lead negotiations on high-stakes enterprise commercial and strategic partnership deals across EMEA (with a strong emphasis on our UK, NL, and IL business), many with significant cross-border elements.

  • Build for scale. Develop and implement an innovative strategy for delivering efficient and effective commercial legal support. Drive the creation and maintenance of scalable templates, playbooks, and processes to support our rapidly growing business.

  • Be a strategic partner. Act as a key advisor to our dynamic, globally distributed commercial leadership. Partner with the Commercial team to scale our go-to-market efforts and advance multi-product and multi-jurisdictional deal strategies.

  • Enhance Efficiency. Learn from our data and operations teams to leverage technology, automation, and data-driven insights to increase the efficiency and impact of the Commercial Legal function.

  • Collaborate Globally. Work closely and effectively with Airwallex’s global legal, compliance, and risk teams on deals and projects that involve multiple jurisdictions

  • Contribute to Culture. Make a positive contribution to the culture of the Airwallex legal team, the EMEA team, and the company as a whole.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Must-Haves:

  • You bring 5-8 years of legal experience, with experience in private practice at a top law firm. Additional in-house experience at a fintech is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent communication, drafting, negotiation, and writing skills.

  • The ability to explain complex legal concepts to various non-legal audiences, and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and deals.

  • High motivation and the ability to operate independently and pivot quickly within a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

  • A learner’s mentality: you are consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges and expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise.

  • A collaborative and empathetic mindset, a good sense of humor, and a keen understanding of how to work effectively with colleagues from different teams and backgrounds.

  • Ability to translate complex legal and risk issues into clear, succinct, and actionable guidance.

  • High integrity, sound judgment, and an unflappable demeanor and collaborative style of working

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience at a fintech or in the banking industry or high-growth and/or globally distributed company.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating technology transactions, SaaS agreements, and other customer-facing services agreements.

  • French/German/Spanish language skills preferred

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions.
